ActorTalk: Once the new semester starts, it'll be the second semester. We'll have to do on-field training on the surface then, right?
Yeah, we'll be partnered with Constructs then. By the way, do you have a preferred Construct type?
It's gotta be Attacker! Offense is the best defense, after all!
Indeed, in terms of individual combat power, Attacker is a good choice. By the way, Gray Raven Commandant, what about you? Which type do you prefer?
Attacker
Support
Tank
Other
Heh, an Attacker as expected.
Though... It's true that all three members of Gray Raven are Attackers right now.
Looks like Attacker is the best choice, then.
I actually think Supports are pretty good too. After all, the battlefield is ever-changing—no one knows what's going to happen in the next moment.
But if you choose a Support Construct, you can also use various support and healing skills if need be, making them more flexible than other types.
Flexible, huh... I suppose you could say that. After all, there are Support frames that can fight just as well as Attackers.
Oh, this one's pretty good too. You get to enhance the frame's forcefield through various means.
Sure, it'll take longer to deal with enemies, but that's a fair trade-off if you can come out of chaotic battles unscathed, right?!
Come to think of it, Chrome's Strike Hawk mostly consists of Tanks too.
Looks like Tank's the best choice... if we're talking about solo operations.
Other types... True, there are also rarer frame types like Amplifiers.
Uh... What's that?
...Forget about the internship, I'm more worried about whether you can even graduate.
